facts: hello API version is diagnostic u32; daemon does not refuse skew. Finite caller uses hello then robot.health or subscribe accepted then robot.state.

HealthResult required healthy; degraded defaultsfalse; bus counters defaultzero. Optional battery/motor/CPU/loop/IMU absence never becomes a measurement. Present ImuHealth defaults each member; FROZEN_RUN25.
LoopHealth ticks/missed/last_tick_age_ms u64, bus errorsu32, IMU staleu64. Health values/counters are diagnostic, never movement authority.
robot.subscribe hz is optionalu32, daemon decimates by positiveHz. This finite observer bounds requestedHz1..50 and closes after one complete state.
State t daemon-uptime seconds and t_ns common CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds. Legacyt_ns0 unavailable; exactu64 representation preserved.

Existing conservative state selectors preserve omitted/empty optional telemetry as not_reported; move.limited_by serde default markedexplicitly. No velocity inference, current direction, FK, control or CLI composite is implemented.
